title: Central EventViewV1
description: One durable event as served by GET /v1/runs/{id}/events and the SSE stream. seq is the per-run durable sequence (the SSE event id); kind is the domain variant name; at is UTC milliseconds; payload is the redacted variant body. Clients must treat events as notifications and public data, never replay them to compute domain state.

seq.description: Durable per-run sequence. Strictly increasing; survives restarts.

at.description: Commit time, UTC milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

payload.description: Redacted variant body. Never carries credentials.
